outputs.explanation: P-values from a Wilcoxon rank-sum test are shown for each gene, but the legend does not state how many spatial spots/samples/animals contributed to the T11b-high versus T11b-low comparison, nor the type of replicate (e.g., number of spots per group, number of tumor regions or animals).
